outcome: Breastfeeding within one hour of birth
cohort: 768 puerperal women from 11 maternities in Sergipe, Brazil
finding: Cesarean section was negatively associated with breastfeeding incentive practices, and intrapartum cesarean section increased the risk of early maternal complications and sexual dysfunction.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was negatively associated with breastfeeding incentive practices, and intrapartum cesarean section increased the risk of early maternal complications and sexual dysfunction.
